summary: Angel Studios (NYSE American: ANGX) filed an 8-K reporting a Second Amended and Restated Merger Agreement dated September 17, 2026, to acquire Toothy Cow Productions, LLC. The all-stock deal was revised to reallocate Class A shares among TCP common and preferred unitholders. No price per share, premium, or close date is stated. The transaction was previously disclosed in 2025 and amended June 2026. The filing provides no board recommendation or advisor. The deal's delayed closing and repeated amendments raise completion risk, while the equity consideration could dilute existing holders.
